text:
Marta: @eng-security quick ping — PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4028. Adds onprem auth proxy, env var handling, and a small migration for key storage. Need security eyes on secrets surface + VPC egress. Planning to merge Wed EOD unless any blockers. @Kevin @Samir
Kevin: looking now — high-level seems fine. One quick nit about env var names, and I'll check proxy egress rules.
Marta: thx — can rename in a follow-up if you prefer. main blocker is: should we keep client certs as a KMS-wrapped file shipped with config or move to Vault? Onprem customers will need rotation notes.
Samir: prefer Vault for both security and rotation. If we go Vault, ensure we never write unencrypted certs to disk and add a migration path for current installs. Also add an audit log hook for auth updates.
Olivia: also, please don't add a broad service account. Scope perms to the minimum (eg: auth:read or vault:secrets:get). I can review IAM once code changes land.
Marta: updated branch with Vault integration and a minimal SA change. PTAL. Added docs + migration snippet: ```bash
# migration helper (pseudo)
vault kv put secret/onprem/auth client_cert=@cert.pem
```
Kevin: quick thing in proxy.yaml — CI currently tests with egress: 0.0.0.0/0. We should restrict to customer VPC CIDRs or internal 10.0.0.0/8 ranges. I'll leave an inline suggestion.
sec-bot: Static scan complete — no leaked creds found. Vulnerability flags: 1 medium lib (openssl) from base image; no high severity. See report: https://scans.internal/reports/2390012345
Samir: thanks. I'll re-run the internal smoke with Vault enabled. I can approve once egress is narrowed and we confirm no plaintext certs in artifacts. @Marta can you confirm both?
Marta: confirmed — egress narrowed to internal CIDRs, Vault used for certs, removed KMS-wrapped-file path. I also added rollback instructions and a short runbook for onprem ops.
deploy-bot: onprem deploy window requested — Tue 09:00 PST reserved (ticket #OPS-721).
Olivia: CI is green on the latest push. Two minor comments left on IAM scope, otherwise fine.
Kevin: approved :thumbsup:
Samir: approved after verifying Vault migration :white_check_mark:
Marta: thanks everyone — I'll merge tomorrow morning and coordinate the onprem deploy with Ops. Leaving the merge window note in the PR.
